notes.title: Patch Notes For 0.8D
notes.notes:
[h2]Summary[/h2]

0.8D is mostly focused on ironing out smaller issues and expanding support for playtesters while preparing for more major gameplay changes with 0.9

[h2]Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*] New hallway segment, the gate hallway with a three-wide gate in the middle
[*] Added additional native ultrawide support in various menus and areas of gameplay
[/list]

[h2]Changes/Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Adjusted startup logo timing
[*] Fixed 'start foundation' options to have more accurate labeling and correct bolding when hovered
[*] Fixed an issue causing maintenance staff to move into unhandled areas of the map, causing pawn duplication
[*] The terminal now refreshes when buildings are complete, meaning menus that interact with requirements (like the hire menu with Class-D and intelligence agents) are now always up to date
[*] Fixed an issue causing blueprints to split and act strangely when zooming in/out 
[*] Fixed a bounds check issue in the load menu, allowing players to navigate to pages that contained no saves
[*] Fixed an issue with loading other sites which involved how the zoom updated
[*] Increased truncation of the 'other elements in tile' readout to prevent overlapping of UI elements
[*] Fixed an issue with access hallway placement not being recognized as valid
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Players can contain the same SCP at multiple sites, this bug will stay for a patch due to some changes I'm working on with containment and some new SCPs
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes For Build 0.8C
notes.notes:
[h2]Overview[/h2]

This patch fixes a number of issues introduced with the wider rollout of 0.8B, making the game far more testable for its mechanics and balance.

[h2]Changes/Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the access hall to placed over a containment chamber in an awkward way
[*] Fixed a soft-lock when investigating multiple SCPs caused by the incorrect dismissal of IA agents when investigating new leads
[*] Added a work-around for construction pawns who get temporarily stuck behind multiple walls after constructing a segment
[*] Fixed multiple terminal/management panel thread lockups
[*] When you press escape while in the management menu, you will now exit the management menu instead of entering the escape menu, an additional press while viewing your site will enter the escape menu
[*] Fixed file content pagination in the files tab of the management menu
[*] Fixed a number of issues with the loading of save slots and the internal selection/reading of saves
[*] Fixed an issue causing tests on SCP-999 to be unreasonably prone to riots
[*] Fixed an issue causing some bodies to be non-walkable leading to pathfinding issues
[*] Fixed an issue causing blueprints to not appear while placing them and switching zoom levels
[*] Added a [b]temporary workaround[/b] for people with non-standard aspect ratios like 21:9, UI elements should now appear as normal with some extra margin on each side of the screen, clicking to move the cursor may not work as expected
[*] Fixed an issue with demolishing segments which caused isolated sections and unresolvable paths
[*] Fixed an issue with the initialization of new sites that caused a thread lockup
[*] Added a 'home room' system where staff will evenly distribute themselves between the available department rooms, they will redistribute periodically
[*] Fixed an issue stopping players from assigning any zone except the first created
[*] Removed the '!' notification system to prepare for a notification feed coming in 0.9
[*] Fixed an issue marking the office room as markup 'none', also assigned a color to the floor of the office
[*] Side terminal navigation is now [b]relative[/b], meaning pressing 'c' returns to the previous menu, making placing different kinds of segments in quick succession more smooth
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes For Build 0.8B
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes/Changes[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed access halls to intersect containment chambers awkwardly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused intelligence agents to not be correctly unassigned from an SCP lead when it was contained, leading to a soft-lock
[*] Fixed an issue with the continue button on the main menu that would not correctly trigger a load from the grid manager
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the player from placing new segments in the same area as a previously demolished one
[*] Temporarily disabled acquisition profiles of 106 and 714 while they're still being worked on
[*] Fixed an issue causing saves to fail when a test was occurring
[*] Fixed an issue that caused starting a new game in an existing save slot to not overwrite the existing saves

[/list] 

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list] 
[*] Researchers may try to start tests even when riots are occurring
[*] The finance graph in the overview menu may incorrectly display sometimes
[*] Breaches may be too deadly and wipe your entire site (balance problem)
[*] Minor UI jank in places like the files menu
[*] General balance issues (provide feedback)
[/list] 

[h2]Testing Instructions[/h2]

Play the build and report any issues you find on our discord (there will be many, I'm sure).

And lastly, please be patient with the game and with us as we work to improve it, thank you!
